entities.name: Mihail II
entities.description: Emperor of Vodalia, a merfolk of the Stovorod caste who served in the military in his youth.

entities.name: Annika
entities.description: Empress of Vodalia, former schoolteacher and Svyelunite, Mihail's wife.

entities.name: Felisia
entities.description: Princess, intelligent and opinionated daughter of Mihail and Annika.

entities.name: Marja
entities.description: Princess, quiet and thoughtful daughter of Mihail and Annika.
